title: Paper Towel Holder Stand 14.4-Inch Solid Brass | Antique Copper | Freestanding | Carolina | Allied Brass
short_title: Paper Towel Holder Stand 14.4-Inch, Antique Copper
description:
Keep paper towels within easy reach without using wall space—this freestanding paper towel holder keeps the roll upright and stable on your kitchen counter in Antique Copper, which brings warm, reddish-brown tones with natural variation, perfect for rustic or craftsman-style kitchens.

Highlights:
- Antique Copper creates an inviting, organic feel
- Coordinates with other Carolina hardware for artisan-inspired warmth
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your kitchen
- Coordinate your kitchen with the Carolina Collection for a matching Carolina look across your hardware
- Built for everyday use from solid brass with a durable designer finish

Specs & Installation:
- Collection: Carolina (traditional/classic styling)
- Material: Brass
- Mounting type: Freestanding; no assembly required
- Overall size: 6.5 in L x 6.5 in W x 14.4 in H (projection 6.5 in)
- Weight capacity: 5 lb
- Product weight: 4 lb
- Included: Paper towel holder
Multiple designer finish options available
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
